features.name: User Registration and Profiles
features.description: Students sign up with a university email and manage a profile with their courses and major.
user_stories: As a student, I can register with my university email so that only verified students join the platform.
As a student, I can edit my profile with my courses and major so that peers can find me.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid university email, When I submit the registration form, Then a verification email is sent and my account is created.
Given I am logged in, When I update my profile and save, Then the changes appear on my public profile immediately.

features.name: Study Notes Sharing
features.description: Students upload, browse, search, and rate study notes organized by university, course, and topic.
user_stories: As a student, I can upload notes in PDF or image format so that classmates can use them.
As a student, I can search and filter notes by course and topic so that I quickly find relevant material.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I upload a supported file under 20 MB with a title and course, Then the note is published and listed.
Given notes exist, When I search by course or keyword, Then matching notes are returned sorted by relevance or rating.

features.name: Study Groups
features.description: Students create, discover, and join study groups for specific courses with group membership management.
user_stories: As a student, I can create a study group for a course so that I can collaborate with classmates.
As a group admin, I can approve or remove members so that the group stays focused and safe.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I create a group with a name and course, Then the group is created and I become its admin.
Given a private group, When a student requests to join, Then the admin sees the request and can approve or reject it.

features.name: Group Discussion and Messaging
features.description: Group members post messages, share notes, and discuss topics within a group feed with notifications.
user_stories: As a group member, I can post messages and attach notes so that the group can discuss study material.
As a student, I can receive notifications about new group activity so that I do not miss important updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am a group member, When I post a message, Then all members see it in the group feed within 5 seconds.
Given I enabled notifications, When a new post is made in my group, Then I receive an in-app notification.

features.name: Moderation and Reporting
features.description: Users report inappropriate or copyrighted content and moderators review and remove it.
user_stories: As a student, I can report a note or post so that inappropriate content is reviewed.
As a moderator, I can review reports and remove content so that the platform remains safe and compliant.
acceptance_criteria: Given I view a note or post, When I submit a report with a reason, Then the report is queued for moderator review.
Given a pending report, When a moderator removes the content, Then it is hidden from users and the uploader is notified.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Pages load in under 2 seconds and search returns results in under 1 second at 500 concurrent users.
All traffic uses HTTPS, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and uploaded files are virus-scanned before publishing.
The platform achieves 99.5% monthly uptime excluding scheduled maintenance.
User data is deletable on request within 30 days, in line with GDPR principles.
Core flows such as upload note and join group are completable in 3 clicks or fewer on mobile and desktop.
